`cw-party` is shipped as v30.79 (commit c67cad02). The gate passed and the seed 4242 fingerprint held at ents 85/374 and containers 165/593. I haven't looked at it on screen; the checks stage the boot with stand-ins.

**What now works with `?party=1`**
- **Host window:** `<game>?party=1&pair=CODE` skips the title and enters the arcade straight away. It never calls `window.open`.
- **Player 2 window:** `<game>?p2=1&mode=coop&arc=1&party=1&pair=CODE` never shows its title and goes straight to the arcade attract.
- **Re-link:** the host posts `hostup` at every boot and every 5 s while nobody is linked. A player 2 window that isn't linked answers `ready`, so a reload of either window finds its pair again.
- **Career and stash:** any way out of the arcade except the operator's Exit demo reloads into the party attract. It reloads at most 4 times in 30 s, so a build that can't enter the arcade doesn't spin. Exit demo goes to the same address without `?party`, the full title. The title rows are hidden by CSS. A host with no pair keeps only the 2 player arcade row.
- **Stale marks:** `p2raid` and `p2live` are cleared at a party boot.
- **Without `?party=1`:** nothing changes (check f).
- **Pad rule (item 5):** no pad change was needed; `cw-p2pads` had already put both windows on pick -1.

I merged all the checks into one key, `cw-party`, rather than one key each, and skipped the pad check because `cw-p2pads` had already shipped it. The write-up with the exact addresses is in `notes\05-party-launch-mode.md`.

**For the session:** set `URL_OPTIONS=1` in `tools\party\party.cfg`, and move the 2-player fuzz robots' fake pad (`tools\fuzz.ps1` + `tools\fuzz-pad.js`) from slot 2 to slot 0, since player 2 now takes the first pad.
